thread:
olivia: quick fyi — uploaded a compact-mode mock for the routing rules list. trying to fit 12 rules on a 1280 width without scrolling. thoughts? https://img.redwood/mock/compact-rules-v2.png
marissa: nice. main thing i worried about — how do we show the active priority drag handle in compact? needs a stronger affordance than just a faint line.
dan: agree. maybe increase hit target and add a subtle background on hover. also keyboard reorder needs to be obvious (up/down chevrons).
samir: compact mode looks tight. validation messages get lost when collapsed tho. if a rule fails validation we should show a condensed error pill inline (red dot + short text) that expands in the preview panel.
olivia: good call. current mock tried to hide errors to save space but that caused confusion in testing. what about a 1-line error summary under the rule title, e.g., "Invalid match: missing header"?
marissa: +1 but shorten copy: "missing header match" is enough. save the full message to the preview drawer.
abel: accessibility nit — when the list collapses, focus order changes. keyboard users shouldn't lose context when a rule expands. we should keep focus on the rule header and reveal details without moving focus.
marissa: right. prefer using aria-expanded on the header and animate height only, no DOM reordering.
ux-bot: reminder: color contrast check failed for the error pill in compact mode (contrast ratio 3.8:1). needs >=4.5:1 for small text.
samir: ok i'll update color tokens. propose #B3302C for pill background and white text.
dan: for reordering UX, tiny suggestion — show a live rank number badge to the left that updates during drag so users can see the impact even if the list is compressed.
olivia: i like the rank badge idea. keeps mental model. can we make it optional (toggle in prefs) for power users?
marissa: optional is fine, default on for new users.
abel: copy tweak for the preview stage: current button "Run Simulation" -> change to "Simulate Traffic" (more explicit). also add microcopy under the button: "Uses cached prefixes; toggle full-run for cold-start results."
olivia: perfect. last bit: the preview panel should have a collapsed/expanded context toggle so users can show the request/response trace only when needed. keeps the main canvas clean.
dan: implementation note — avoid rendering full eval trace until expanded to save memory. lazy fetch on expand with loading skeleton.
marissa: test plan: 1) keyboard reordering flows, 2) error-pill discoverability, 3) drag handle hit-targets on <1280 widths, 4) contrast checks, 5) simulate button wording A/B. i'll add these to the UX checklist.
olivia: thanks all — i'll push an updated mock with rank badges + error pill + new copy by EOD. ping me if you want to pair on the skeleton fetch logic. :thumbsup:
marissa: (reacted :eyes:)
